Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: The latest jobs report shows unemployment edging down to 7.2%, bringing a mix of relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant offers authentic Swiss cuisine—including cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue—in a cozy, alpine-inspired setting. The website highlights rustic wooden interiors, panoramic city views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. Your page is straightforward, and having your email available makes it easy to contact you. Based on the content I could read, I'd suggest adding a short introduction about yourself and a few examples of your interests or work to give visitors a stronger sense of who you are.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning hiking gives your blog a personal touch and a clear starting point for future posts. Based on the content I could read, I'd love to see stories from your hikes, favorite trails, photos, and practical tips—those would make the blog more engaging and useful for fellow hikers.
